staging.logistics: Van is already staged on a prepared roadhead/service apron through expedition logistics. Travel to this remote region is a campaign transition; no new vehicle, ferry or flight gameplay is assumed.

circulation: Haul circuit gives two approaches to the ore rooms. A graded ventilation return reaches the adit without the lift. Collapsed bay is clearly blocked beyond its reachable viewing area; lower workings have two reserved connections.
systems: Rock conduction, ventilation draft, wet walls and rails are ordinary confounders. Support-timber hazards are visible static boundaries until a host-authorized event exists; no random cave-in may seal every escape.
campaign: Assay records and impossible payroll dates connect provisionally to Blackpine shipping documents. Mine geometry, clues and ghost identity stay separate.
refine: Engineer the adit descent as a long graded drift rather than using the schematic direct line as a steep stair.
Refine shaft void, lower-level gradients and two-way return with headroom and rock boundary tests.
Inspect mine engineering references before detailed supports or ventilation routing.
